name: ir_irct_trial_search
description: Search the Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT, Iran's national registry of clinical trials, a WHO primary registry). Free-text query in English or Persian over titles, conditions, interventions and sponsors, or an IRCT number. Each hit gives the IRCT number, the title and the record link; 25 results per page (page, next_page). Status, phase, sponsor and dates are in ir_irct_trial_get. No hit means none in this registry, not that no such trial exists. Example: query="gastric cancer".

query.description: Words from the title, condition, intervention or sponsor in English or Persian, or an IRCT number.

page.description: Result page, 25 per page (default 1); use next_page from the previous answer.

limit.description: Trials returned from the page (1-25, default 10).

name: ir_irct_trial_get
description: Fetch one Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (IRCT) record by IRCT number (from ir_irct_trial_search): scientific and public titles, recruitment status, study type and design, phase, condition, intervention, sponsor organisation, contact organisations, target sample size, countries, registration, enrolment-start and completion dates, secondary identifiers and the record link. Registrants', investigators' and contacts' names, e-mail addresses, telephone numbers and street addresses are not returned. An unknown number returns found false. Example: trial_id="IRCT2016080318745N10".
